name: Ascorbic Acid
description: A water-soluble vitamin essential for collagen synthesis, immune function, and antioxidant protection. Found in citrus fruits, berries, and vegetables. Used in supplements, skincare, and as a food preservative.

name: Chloramphenicol
description: A broad-spectrum antibiotic used to treat bacterial infections, including typhoid fever and meningitis. It inhibits bacterial protein synthesis but has serious side effects like bone marrow suppression.

name: Phenol
description: A caustic aromatic compound used as an antiseptic, disinfectant, and precursor in plastic and pharmaceutical manufacturing. Toxic in high doses.

name: Dexamethasone
description: A potent corticosteroid used to treat inflammation, allergic reactions, and autoimmune conditions. Also used for managing severe COVID-19 cases.

name: Adenosine
description: A nucleoside involved in energy transfer (ATP) and cellular signaling. Used in medicine to treat irregular heartbeats (arrhythmias) and in research for its role in biochemical reactions.

name: Testosterone
description: The primary male sex hormone, responsible for muscle growth, bone density, and secondary sexual characteristics. Used medically in hormone replacement therapy.

name: Cytarabine
description: A chemotherapy drug used to treat leukemia and lymphoma by interfering with DNA synthesis.

name: Ethanol
description: A widely used solvent and antiseptic. Found in alcoholic beverages and used as a fuel additive.

name: Estrone
description: A naturally occurring estrogen hormone involved in female reproductive health. Used in hormone replacement therapy.

name: Erythromycin
description: A macrolide antibiotic used to treat respiratory tract infections, skin infections, and sexually transmitted diseases.

name: Linezolid
description: Linezolid is an antibiotic used to treat infections caused by Gram-positive bacteria, including pneumonia and skin infections. It works by inhibiting bacterial protein synthesis.

name: Meloxicam
description: Meloxicam is a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) used to relieve pain and inflammation in conditions such as arthritis. It inhibits cyclooxygenase enzymes to reduce inflammation.

name: Paclitaxel
description: Paclitaxel is a chemotherapy drug used to treat various types of cancer, including breast and ovarian cancer. It stabilizes microtubules and prevents cell division.

name: Acetylcysteine
description: Acetylcysteine is a mucolytic agent used to treat respiratory conditions with excessive mucus production. It also acts as an antidote for acetaminophen overdose.

name: Hydrochlorothiazide
description: Hydrochlorothiazide is a diuretic medication used to treat high blood pressure and fluid retention. It helps the kidneys remove excess sodium and water from the body.

name: Tylosin
description: Tylosin is a macrolide antibiotic primarily used in veterinary medicine to treat bacterial infections in livestock and poultry.

name: Lincomycin
description: Lincomycin is an antibiotic used to treat severe bacterial infections, particularly those caused by Gram-positive bacteria. It inhibits bacterial protein synthesis.

name: Spectinomycin
description: Spectinomycin is an antibiotic used to treat gonorrhea infections. It works by inhibiting bacterial protein synthesis.

name: Ethylenediamine
description: Ethylenediamine is an organic compound used as a building block in the synthesis of many industrial chemicals, including pharmaceuticals and agrochemicals.

name: Bortezomib
description: Bortezomib is a proteasome inhibitor used in the treatment of multiple myeloma and mantle cell lymphoma. It disrupts protein degradation pathways in cancer cells.

name: Ondansetron
description: Ondansetron is an antiemetic medication used to prevent nausea and vomiting caused by chemotherapy, radiation therapy, or surgery. It works by blocking serotonin receptors in the brain.

name: Streptomycin Sulfate
description: Streptomycin sulfate is an aminoglycoside antibiotic used to treat bacterial infections, including tuberculosis and plague. It works by inhibiting protein synthesis in bacteria.

name: Oxytetracycline hydrochloride
description: Oxytetracycline is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used to treat bacterial infections in humans and animals. It works by inhibiting bacterial protein synthesis.

name: Propofol
description: Propofol is a short-acting intravenous anesthetic used for induction and maintenance of general anesthesia. It is also used for sedation in intensive care settings.

name: Diazoxide
description: Diazoxide is a vasodilator used to treat acute hypertension and hypoglycemia in patients with insulinoma. It works by relaxing blood vessels and reducing insulin secretion.

name: Nitroglycerin
description: Nitroglycerin is a nitrate medication used to treat angina (chest pain) and heart failure. It works by dilating blood vessels to improve blood flow.

name: Midazolam
description: Midazolam is a benzodiazepine used for sedation, anesthesia, and seizure control. It enhances the effects of GABA in the brain, promoting relaxation and sleep.

name: Etomidate
description: Etomidate is an intravenous anesthetic used for short surgical procedures. It provides rapid induction of anesthesia with minimal cardiovascular effects.

name: Pemetrexed
description: Pemetrexed is a chemotherapy drug used to treat non-small cell lung cancer and mesothelioma. It inhibits folate metabolism, preventing cancer cell growth.

name: Polidocanol
description: Polidocanol is a sclerosing agent used in treating varicose veins and spider veins. It works by irritating blood vessel linings, causing them to collapse.

name: Florfenicol
description: Florfenicol is a veterinary antibiotic used to treat bacterial infections in livestock. It is a fluorinated analog of chloramphenicol.

name: Water
description: Water is a universal solvent essential for life. It is used in pharmaceuticals, laboratories, and medical treatments.

name: Perflutren
description: Perflutren is a fluorocarbon gas used in ultrasound contrast agents to improve imaging of blood flow.

name: Daptomycin
description: Daptomycin is an antibiotic used to treat serious bacterial infections, particularly those caused by Gram-positive bacteria, including MRSA.

name: Clindamycin Phosphate
description: Clindamycin phosphate is a prodrug of clindamycin, used to treat bacterial infections, including skin infections and acne.

name: Tylosin Tartrate
description: Tylosin is a macrolide antibiotic used in veterinary medicine to treat bacterial infections in livestock.

name: Humulin N
description: Humulin N is an intermediate-acting insulin used to treat diabetes mellitus by controlling blood sugar levels.

name: Tulathromycin
description: Tulathromycin is a macrolide antibiotic used in veterinary medicine to treat respiratory infections in cattle and swine.
